sentences.text: Neanis is an extinct genus of bird that is probably related to woodpeckers and toucans.
The genus Neanis was described by Shufeldt in 1913.
The family Primobucconidae, which originally included Neanis, has been moved to the order Coraciiformes, placing the genus within the parent group Coracii.
Neanis schucherti appears to share traits with Hassiavis and might even be a cypselomorph.
Fossils of this bird date to the Early Eocene epoch, specifically within the Late Wasatchian stratum of the Green River Formation in the Western-Central USA, dating to 51-52 million years ago.
